ideas.name: any warning after open interest jumped
ideas.why: NQ open interest up 5%+ in the last weekly report: new positions being built behind a trend, so turns fail

ideas.name: any warning with dealers crowded short
ideas.why: dealers' net NQ position in the bottom fifth of the year means they are short futures against client longs (ETF and options flow); their hedging buys dips and sells rips, so turns pay
